mapper.sql: i.*,u.user_name AS owner,r.title AS source_report_title,v.user_name AS accepted_by_name

FROM action_items i JOIN projects p ON p.id=i.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=i.owner_id LEFT JOIN users v ON v.id=i.accepted_by LEFT JOIN reports r ON r.id=i.source_report_id AND r.project_id=i.project_id WHERE i.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED' AND (p.visibility='WORKSPACE' OR p.created_by=#{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE action_items SET title=#{title},description=#{description},owner_id=#{ownerId},due_at=#{dueAt}, priority=#{priority},status=#{status},acceptance_criteria=#{acceptanceCriteria},blocks_release=#{blocksRelease}, completion_evidence=#{completionEvidence},submitted_by=#{submittedBy},submitted_at=#{submittedAt}, accepted_by=#{acceptedBy},accepted_at=#{acceptedAt},acceptance_comment=#{acceptanceComment},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
